item.title: Elouise Marion (nee Callies) Firth
item.description: With broken hearts we share the passing of Marion on December 2, 2025. Marion was born on December 17, 1930, in Wetaskiwin, Alberta, to Elnora (Larson) and Herman Callies. Marion had 5 siblings and grew up on the Family Farm in Gwynne, Alberta. At the age of sixteen, she moved to B.C. and married John Joseph (JOE) McShane. Marion worked in the Retail and Grocery industry until her retirement. For the last 50 years she lived in White Rock, B.C. Marion will be sorely missed by her 3 children Verne
